term: genus and differentia as predicables or real composition principles
resolution: The finite control instantiates existing strict-genus predication clauses and in-genus classification, not q3a5 first/third proof’s further account of real principles, potency/act or esse/essence. q3a7 enumerates genus/differentia composition among real simplicity exclusions, but current Article7 inclusion only encodes matter/form and essence/esse cases. No taxonomic term is silently made a material component, and generic common nature is not substituted for each complete essence. The controls expose the missing realization and causal-exhaustiveness bridges; they do not refute the source after adding those commitments.
